content: Cerberus Book in the Earth Reborn Series Captain Jason  Blackmore ,  is a smuggler, captain bringing much needed supplies to those that need it, however he is caught and in order to keep his ship and freedom he will become a privateer for VICOR, With his chief engineer  Sirus  Albion, a salty (Irishman). First mate Boris  Kilran  they navigate the deadly politics of the crown while trying to save the kingdom.  The Cerberus is a freighter with hidden weapons.
